Novozlatopil (Proletarskoe) Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Novozlatopil — founded in 1848 as Jewish colony Number 7, also known as Grafskaya or informally Gamner/Kamner, and later renamed Proletars'ke from 1924 to 2016 — was settled by Jews from the Vitebsk and Mogilev Governorates and ran a tree nursery supplying saplings across the region. The colony survived a pogrom in May 1881 and further violence during the Civil War of 1918–21 before Soviet collectivization turned it into a state farm; those who could not evacuate before the German occupation in October 1941 were murdered. The cemetery's founding date is unknown, but local residents say it was already gone by the 1970s.
